CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.revoke_integration_approval_scopes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'integration_grants' THEN
        IF NEW.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.enabled OR NEW.version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.version
           OR NEW.approval_policy IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approval_policy
           OR NEW.approval_scope_paths IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approval_scope_paths
           OR NEW.definition_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_version
           OR NEW.definition_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_digest
           OR NEW.resource_scope_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resource_scope_digest THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_approval_scopes
            SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE grant_id=OLD.id AND revoked_at IS NULL;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'integration_connections' THEN
        IF NEW.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.enabled OR NEW.state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.state
           OR NEW.definition_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_version
           OR NEW.definition_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_digest THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_approval_scopes
            SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE connection_id=OLD.id AND revoked_at IS NULL;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'integration_definitions' THEN
        IF NEW.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.enabled OR NEW.digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.digest
           OR NEW.definition_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_version
           OR NEW.adapter_readiness IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.adapter_readiness THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_approval_scopes scope
            SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp()
            WHERE scope.connection_id IN (
                SELECT connection.id FROM control_plane.integration_connections connection
                WHERE connection.definition_key=OLD.stable_key
            ) AND scope.revoked_at IS NULL;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'runs' THEN
        IF NEW.state IN ('CANCELLING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NEW.state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.state THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_approval_scopes
            SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE root_run_id=OLD.id AND revoked_at IS NULL AND scope_lifetime='ROOT_RUN';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.cancel_personal_tests_on_connection_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control_plane'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.version THEN
        UPDATE control_plane.integration_personal_credential_tests
        SET state='CANCELLED',outcome='CANCELLED',version=version+1,finished_at=clock_timestamp(),
            lease_ref=NULL,fence_digest=NULL,workload_instance=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL
        WHERE connection_id=NEW.id AND state IN ('DUE','CLAIMED','PROBING');
        UPDATE control_plane.integration_personal_credentials
        SET state='CHECK_REQUIRED',version=version+1
        WHERE connection_id=NEW.id AND state='CHECKING';
        IF (NEW.public_configuration,NEW.definition_version,NEW.definition_digest,NEW.credential_policy)
           IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.public_configuration,OLD.definition_version,OLD.definition_digest,OLD.credential_policy) THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_personal_credentials
            SET state='CHECK_REQUIRED',version=version+1,verified_credential_revision_id=NULL,
                verified_definition_digest=NULL,verified_configuration_digest=NULL,
                verified_capabilities='{}',denied_capabilities='{}',observed_permission_profiles='{}',expires_at=NULL
            WHERE connection_id=NEW.id AND state IN ('READY','INVALID');
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

control_plane.close_workspace_volume_ori.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.close_workspace_volume_origin()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_task record;
BEGIN
 -- Родительская owner-команда уже удерживает изменяемую строку origin.
 -- Выборка не расширяется на другие actor/project/session этого organization.
 FOR v_task IN
   SELECT t.id,t.volume_id,t.volume_generation
   FROM control_plane.session_workspace_volume_tasks t
   JOIN control_plane.session_workspace_volumes v ON v.id=t.volume_id
   JOIN control_plane.session_workspace_storage w ON w.id=v.workspace_id
   JOIN control_plane.run_nodes n ON n.id=t.origin_node_id
   WHERE t.state IN('READY','CLAIMED') AND (
     TG_TABLE_NAME='runs' AND (t.root_run_id=NEW.id OR n.run_id=NEW.id)
     OR TG_TABLE_NAME='run_nodes' AND t.origin_node_id=NEW.id
     OR TG_TABLE_NAME='sessions' AND w.session_id=NEW.id
     OR TG_TABLE_NAME='agents' AND w.agent_id=NEW.id
     OR TG_TABLE_NAME='projects' AND w.project_id=NEW.id
     OR TG_TABLE_NAME='subjects' AND t.origin_actor_id=NEW.id)
   ORDER BY t.root_run_id,w.session_id,v.id,t.id FOR UPDATE OF v,t
 LOOP
   UPDATE control_plane.session_workspace_volume_attempts SET grant_state='CLOSED'
   WHERE task_id=v_task.id AND grant_state='ACTIVE';
   UPDATE control_plane.session_workspace_volume_tasks
   SET state='CANCELLED',safe_error_code='ORIGIN_CLOSED',completed_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE id=v_task.id AND state IN('READY','CLAIMED');
   UPDATE control_plane.session_workspace_volumes
   SET state='BLOCKED',block_reason='ORIGIN_CLOSED',version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE id=v_task.volume_id AND generation=v_task.volume_generation AND state NOT IN('READY','PURGED');
 END LOOP;
 RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'reserved_effects' - 'revoked_at') IS DISTINCT FROM
       (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'reserved_effects' - 'revoked_at')
       OR NEW.reserved_effects < OLD.reserved_effects
       OR (OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.revoked_at) THEN

    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.guard_legacy_workflow_rework()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control_plane'
AS $function$
DECLARE original record; first_node record;
BEGIN
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME='runs' THEN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.run_nodes node WHERE node.run_id=OLD.id
            AND node.organization_id=OLD.organization_id AND node.owner_rework_gate_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
            IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
                IF NOT control_plane.project_purge_authorized() OR NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.project_purge_targets target
                    JOIN control_plane.project_purge_context context USING (transaction_id)
                    WHERE target.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id_if_assigned() AND context.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
                        AND target.relation_id='control_plane.runs'::regclass AND target.row_key=jsonb_build_array(OLD.id)
                ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy rework run requires exact project purge' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
            ELSIF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.ref,NEW.organization_id,NEW.project_id,NEW.session_id,NEW.root_run_id,NEW.parent_run_id,
                NEW.workflow_version_id,NEW.retry_of_run_id,NEW.target_type,NEW.target_ref,NEW.source,NEW.attempt,NEW.initiated_by,
                NEW.task,NEW.input,NEW.created_at,NEW.started_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
                OLD.id,OLD.ref,OLD.organization_id,OLD.project_id,OLD.session_id,OLD.root_run_id,OLD.parent_run_id,
                OLD.workflow_version_id,OLD.retry_of_run_id,OLD.target_type,OLD.target_ref,OLD.source,OLD.attempt,OLD.initiated_by,
                OLD.task,OLD.input,OLD.created_at,OLD.started_at) THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy rework physical run lineage is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
            END IF;
        END IF;
        IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
        IF OLD.owner_rework_gate_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            IF NOT control_plane.project_purge_authorized() OR NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.project_purge_targets target
                JOIN control_plane.project_purge_context context USING (transaction_id)
                WHERE target.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id_if_assigned() AND context.backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()
                    AND target.relation_id='control_plane.run_nodes'::regclass AND target.row_key=jsonb_build_array(OLD.id)
            ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy rework requires exact authorized project purge' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
        END IF;
        RETURN OLD;
    END IF;
    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.owner_rework_gate_id IS NOT NULL AND ROW(
        NEW.id,NEW.ref,NEW.organization_id,NEW.root_run_id,NEW.run_id,NEW.parent_node_id,NEW.agent_id,
        NEW.turn_id,NEW.workflow_step_key,NEW.attempt,NEW.owner_rework_gate_id,NEW.owner_rework_origin_node_id,NEW.human_gate_after
    ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
        OLD.id,OLD.ref,OLD.organization_id,OLD.root_run_id,OLD.run_id,OLD.parent_node_id,OLD.agent_id,
        OLD.turn_id,OLD.workflow_step_key,OLD.attempt,OLD.owner_rework_gate_id,OLD.owner_rework_origin_node_id,OLD.human_gate_after
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy rework assignment is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.owner_rework_gate_id IS NULL AND NEW.owner_rework_gate_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy rework cannot reinterpret an existing node' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.owner_rework_gate_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
    IF NEW.workflow_business_attempt<>0 OR NEW.workflow_step_origin_node_id IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.type<>'AGENT_EXECUTION' OR NEW.materialization_state<>'MATERIALIZED' OR NOT NEW.human_gate_after THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy rework cannot impersonate SERVER provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT predecessor.id AS node_id,predecessor.run_id,logical_origin.workflow_step_key,
           predecessor.agent_id,prior.attempt AS run_attempt,prior.project_id,prior.initiated_by,
           root.id AS root_id,root.workflow_version_id
    INTO original
    FROM control_plane.owner_gates gate
    JOIN control_plane.run_nodes gate_node ON gate_node.id=gate.node_id AND gate_node.organization_id=gate.organization_id
        AND gate_node.root_run_id=gate.root_run_id AND gate_node.type='HUMAN_GATE'
    JOIN control_plane.run_nodes predecessor ON predecessor.id=gate_node.parent_node_id
        AND predecessor.organization_id=gate.organization_id AND predecessor.root_run_id=gate.root_run_id
    JOIN LATERAL control_plane.legacy_workflow_step_origin(NEW.organization_id,predecessor.id) AS origin_id(id) ON true
    JOIN control_plane.run_nodes logical_origin ON logical_origin.id=origin_id.id AND logical_origin.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
    JOIN control_plane.runs prior ON prior.id=predecessor.run_id AND prior.organization_id=gate.organization_id
    JOIN control_plane.runs root ON root.id=gate.root_run_id AND root.organization_id=gate.organization_id
        AND root.project_id=gate.project_id AND root.project_id=prior.project_id AND root.id<>prior.id
    JOIN control_plane.workflow_versions version ON version.id=root.workflow_version_id AND version.organization_id=root.organization_id
    JOIN control_plane.workflows workflow ON workflow.id=version.workflow_id AND workflow.organization_id=root.organization_id
        AND workflow.project_id=root.project_id
    JOIN control_plane.agents agent ON agent.id=predecessor.agent_id AND agent.organization_id=root.organization_id
        AND agent.project_id=root.project_id
    WHERE gate.id=NEW.owner_rework_gate_id AND gate.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND gate.root_run_id=NEW.root_run_id
        AND gate.state='CHANGES_REQUESTED' AND gate.decision='REQUEST_CHANGES'
        AND gate.allowed_decisions @> ARRAY['REQUEST_CHANGES']::text[] AND gate.integration_invocation_id IS NULL
        AND gate.scope_kind='PROJECT' AND COALESCE(version.spec->>'ExecutionMode','')<>'SERVER_DAG_V1'
        AND predecessor.workflow_business_attempt=0 AND predecessor.workflow_step_origin_node_id IS NULL
        AND predecessor.state='SUCCEEDED' AND prior.state='SUCCEEDED'
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(version.spec->'Steps') step(value)
            WHERE step.value->>'Key'=logical_origin.workflow_step_key AND step.value->>'AgentRef'=agent.ref
                AND step.value->>'HumanGateAfter'='true');
    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.agent_id<>original.agent_id OR NEW.workflow_step_key<>original.workflow_step_key
        OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.runs physical
            JOIN control_plane.session_turns turn ON turn.id=NEW.turn_id AND turn.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
                AND turn.run_id=physical.id AND turn.session_id=physical.session_id
            WHERE physical.id=NEW.run_id AND physical.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
                AND physical.root_run_id=original.root_id AND physical.project_id=original.project_id
                AND physical.workflow_version_id=original.workflow_version_id
                AND physical.retry_of_run_id=original.run_id AND physical.attempt=original.run_attempt+1
                AND physical.source='AGENT_DELEGATION' AND physical.initiated_by=original.initiated_by)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy rework does not match its stored owner decision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF NEW.owner_rework_origin_node_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT * INTO first_node FROM control_plane.run_nodes origin WHERE origin.id=NEW.owner_rework_origin_node_id;
        IF NOT FOUND OR first_node.id=NEW.id OR first_node.owner_rework_origin_node_id IS NOT NULL
            OR first_node.owner_rework_gate_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.owner_rework_gate_id
            OR ROW(first_node.organization_id,first_node.root_run_id,first_node.run_id,first_node.agent_id,first_node.workflow_step_key)
                IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.organization_id,NEW.root_run_id,NEW.run_id,NEW.agent_id,NEW.workflow_step_key)
            OR NEW.attempt<=first_node.attempt THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy technical continuation lost its owner origin' USING ERRCODE='23514';
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.guard_personal_invocation_admission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control_plane'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.integration_invocations invocation
        WHERE invocation.id=NEW.invocation_id AND invocation.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
          AND invocation.state='RUNNING' AND invocation.generation=NEW.generation
          AND invocation.lease_ref=NEW.lease_ref AND invocation.claimed_lease_ref=NEW.lease_ref
          AND invocation.effect_fence_digest=NEW.fence_digest AND invocation.claimed_fence_digest=NEW.fence_digest
          AND invocation.workload_instance=NEW.workload_instance AND invocation.claimed_workload='integration-gateway'
          AND invocation.claimed_recovery_read_only=NEW.recovery_read_only
          AND invocation.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'personal invocation admission lease is invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.guard_personal_invocation_credential()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control_plane'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.integration_invocations invocation
        JOIN control_plane.runs execution ON execution.id=invocation.run_id
          AND execution.organization_id=invocation.organization_id
        JOIN control_plane.runs root ON root.id=execution.root_run_id
          AND root.organization_id=invocation.organization_id AND root.root_run_id=root.id
        JOIN control_plane.subjects subject ON subject.id=root.initiated_by
          AND subject.organization_id=root.organization_id AND subject.active AND subject.kind='USER'
        JOIN control_plane.integration_personal_credentials binding ON binding.id=NEW.binding_id
          AND binding.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND binding.connection_id=NEW.connection_id
          AND binding.subject_id=NEW.subject_id AND binding.generation=NEW.binding_generation
          AND binding.state='READY' AND binding.credential_revision_id=NEW.credential_revision_id
          AND binding.verified_credential_revision_id=NEW.credential_revision_id
          AND binding.verified_definition_digest=NEW.definition_digest
          AND binding.verified_configuration_digest=NEW.configuration_digest
          AND (binding.expires_at IS NULL OR binding.expires_at>clock_timestamp())
        JOIN control_plane.integration_connections connection ON connection.id=invocation.connection_id
          AND connection.organization_id=invocation.organization_id
          AND connection.credential_policy='INITIATOR_REQUIRED'
          AND control_plane.integration_connection_configuration_ready(connection.id)
        WHERE invocation.id=NEW.invocation_id AND invocation.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
          AND root.id=NEW.root_run_id AND root.initiated_by=NEW.subject_id
          AND root.source NOT IN ('SCHEDULE','INTEGRATION')
          AND root.state IN ('RUNNING','WAITING_HUMAN')
          AND invocation.definition_digest=NEW.definition_digest
          AND (
            (NEW.resource_permission_profile=''
              AND invocation.capability_key=ANY(binding.verified_capabilities)
              AND NOT (connection.definition_key='confluence-server-dc'
                AND invocation.capability_key='confluence.page.update')
              AND NOT (connection.definition_key='jira-server-dc'
                AND invocation.capability_key IN ('jira.issue.create','jira.issue.comment.write','jira.issue.transition.apply',
                  'jira.issue.search','jira.issue.read','jira.issue.transition.list'))
              AND NOT (connection.definition_key='confluence-server-dc'
                AND invocation.capability_key IN ('confluence.page.search','confluence.page.read'))
              AND NOT (connection.definition_key='gitlab'
                AND invocation.capability_key IN ('gitlab.repository.file.read','gitlab.issue.read','gitlab.merge_request.read','gitlab.pipeline.read',
                  'gitlab.issue.create','gitlab.branch.create','gitlab.merge_request.create')))
            OR (NEW.resource_permission_profile='CONFLUENCE_SERVER_PAGE_UPDATE_V1'
              AND connection.definition_key='confluence-server-dc'
              AND invocation.capability_key='confluence.page.update'
              AND invocation.operation='confluence.page.update'
              AND invocation.risk='WRITE' AND invocation.approval_policy='HUMAN_EACH_EFFECT'
              AND invocation.resource_kind='CONFLUENCE_SPACE'
              AND binding.verified_capabilities @> ARRAY['confluence.space.read','confluence.identity.read']::text[]
              AND NOT binding.denied_capabilities && ARRAY['confluence.space.read','confluence.identity.read']::text[])
            OR (connection.definition_key='jira-server-dc'
              AND ((NEW.resource_permission_profile='JIRA_SERVER_ISSUE_CREATE_V1' AND invocation.capability_key='jira.issue.create')
                OR (NEW.resource_permission_profile='JIRA_SERVER_COMMENT_WRITE_V1' AND invocation.capability_key='jira.issue.comment.write')
                OR (NEW.resource_permission_profile='JIRA_SERVER_TRANSITION_APPLY_V1' AND invocation.capability_key='jira.issue.transition.apply'))
              AND invocation.operation=invocation.capability_key
              AND invocation.risk='WRITE' AND invocation.approval_policy='HUMAN_EACH_EFFECT'
              AND invocation.resource_kind='JIRA_PROJECT'
              AND binding.verified_capabilities @> ARRAY['jira.project.read','jira.identity.read']::text[]
              AND NOT binding.denied_capabilities && ARRAY['jira.project.read','jira.identity.read']::text[])
            OR (connection.definition_key='gitlab'
              AND ((NEW.resource_permission_profile='GITLAB_PROJECT_ISSUE_CREATE_V1'
                  AND invocation.capability_key='gitlab.issue.create' AND invocation.risk='WRITE')
                OR (NEW.resource_permission_profile='GITLAB_PROJECT_BRANCH_CREATE_V1'
                  AND invocation.capability_key='gitlab.branch.create' AND invocation.risk='SENSITIVE')
                OR (NEW.resource_permission_profile='GITLAB_PROJECT_MERGE_REQUEST_CREATE_V1'
                  AND invocation.capability_key='gitlab.merge_request.create' AND invocation.risk='SENSITIVE'))
              AND invocation.operation=invocation.capability_key AND invocation.approval_policy='HUMAN_EACH_EFFECT'
              AND invocation.resource_kind='GITLAB_PROJECT'
              AND binding.observed_permission_profiles @> ARRAY['GITLAB_PROJECT_WRITE_SCOPE_V1']::text[]
              AND binding.verified_capabilities @> ARRAY['gitlab.project.metadata.read']::text[]
              AND NOT binding.denied_capabilities && ARRAY['gitlab.project.metadata.read']::text[])
            OR (NEW.resource_permission_profile='GITLAB_PROJECT_OBJECT_READ_V1'
              AND connection.definition_key='gitlab'
              AND invocation.capability_key IN ('gitlab.repository.file.read','gitlab.issue.read','gitlab.merge_request.read','gitlab.pipeline.read')
              AND invocation.operation=invocation.capability_key
              AND invocation.risk='READ' AND invocation.approval_policy='NONE'
              AND invocation.resource_kind='GITLAB_PROJECT'
              AND binding.verified_capabilities @> ARRAY['gitlab.project.metadata.read']::text[]
              AND NOT binding.denied_capabilities && ARRAY['gitlab.project.metadata.read']::text[])
            OR (NEW.resource_permission_profile='JIRA_SERVER_PROJECT_OBJECT_READ_V1'
              AND connection.definition_key='jira-server-dc'
              AND invocation.capability_key IN ('jira.issue.search','jira.issue.read','jira.issue.transition.list')
              AND invocation.operation=invocation.capability_key
              AND invocation.risk='READ' AND invocation.approval_policy='NONE'
              AND invocation.resource_kind='JIRA_PROJECT'
              AND binding.verified_capabilities @> ARRAY['jira.project.read','jira.identity.read']::text[]
              AND NOT binding.denied_capabilities && ARRAY['jira.project.read','jira.identity.read']::text[])
            OR (NEW.resource_permission_profile='CONFLUENCE_SERVER_SPACE_OBJECT_READ_V1'
              AND connection.definition_key='confluence-server-dc'
              AND invocation.capability_key IN ('confluence.page.search','confluence.page.read')
              AND invocation.operation=invocation.capability_key
              AND invocation.risk='READ' AND invocation.approval_policy='NONE'
              AND invocation.resource_kind='CONFLUENCE_SPACE'
              AND binding.verified_capabilities @> ARRAY['confluence.space.read','confluence.identity.read']::text[]
              AND NOT binding.denied_capabilities && ARRAY['confluence.space.read','confluence.identity.read']::text[])
          )
          AND NOT invocation.capability_key=ANY(binding.denied_capabilities)
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'personal invocation credential lineage is invalid' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.guard_ssh_compose_admission_block()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.ssh_compose_admission_blocked OR NEW.ssh_compose_admission_blocked THEN
    IF NEW.ssh_compose_snapshot IS NULL
       OR NEW.operation NOT IN ('ssh.compose.inspect','ssh.compose.deploy','ssh.compose.status')
       OR NEW.effect_receipt_id IS NOT NULL
       OR (OLD.ssh_compose_admission_blocked AND
          (NOT NEW.ssh_compose_admission_blocked OR
           NEW.ssh_compose_admission_block_reason IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ssh_compose_admission_block_reason))
       OR ROW(NEW.id,NEW.organization_id,NEW.run_id,NEW.node_id,NEW.connection_id,
              NEW.grant_id,NEW.grant_version,NEW.capability_key,NEW.idempotency_key,NEW.intent_digest,NEW.approval_scope_id,NEW.approval_scope_paths,NEW.mailbox_gate_required,NEW.definition_version,NEW.definition_digest,
              NEW.operation,NEW.risk,NEW.approval_policy,NEW.resource_kind,NEW.resource_scope,
              NEW.resource_scope_digest,NEW.effect_key,NEW.input_digest,NEW.bounded_input,
              NEW.ssh_compose_snapshot,NEW.ssh_compose_deadline,NEW.ssh_compose_recovery,
              NEW.generation,NEW.claimed_workload,NEW.claimed_lease_ref,NEW.claimed_fence_digest,
              NEW.effect_receipt_id)
          IS DISTINCT FROM
          ROW(OLD.id,OLD.organization_id,OLD.run_id,OLD.node_id,OLD.connection_id,
              OLD.grant_id,OLD.grant_version,OLD.capability_key,OLD.idempotency_key,OLD.intent_digest,OLD.approval_scope_id,OLD.approval_scope_paths,OLD.mailbox_gate_required,OLD.definition_version,OLD.definition_digest,
              OLD.operation,OLD.risk,OLD.approval_policy,OLD.resource_kind,OLD.resource_scope,
              OLD.resource_scope_digest,OLD.effect_key,OLD.input_digest,OLD.bounded_input,
              OLD.ssh_compose_snapshot,OLD.ssh_compose_deadline,OLD.ssh_compose_recovery,
              OLD.generation,OLD.claimed_workload,OLD.claimed_lease_ref,OLD.claimed_fence_digest,
              OLD.effect_receipt_id)
       OR NEW.lease_ref IS NOT NULL OR NEW.effect_fence_digest IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.workload_instance IS NOT NULL OR NEW.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL
       OR OLD.state NOT IN ('READY','UNKNOWN_OUTCOME','FAILED','CANCELLED')
       OR (NOT OLD.ssh_compose_admission_blocked AND NEW.state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.state)
       OR (OLD.state='UNKNOWN_OUTCOME' AND
           ROW(NEW.state,NEW.result_summary,NEW.safe_error_code) IS DISTINCT FROM
           ROW(OLD.state,OLD.result_summary,OLD.safe_error_code))
       OR (OLD.state<>'UNKNOWN_OUTCOME' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('READY','FAILED','CANCELLED')) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'SSH Compose blocked admission is immutable';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

control_plane.integration_connection_con.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.integration_connection_configuration_ready(p_connection_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control_plane'
AS $function$
SELECT COALESCE((
    SELECT connection.enabled AND connection.lifecycle_state='ACTIVE'
      AND definition.enabled AND definition.adapter_readiness='READY'
      AND (definition.adapter_owner,definition.execution_route) IN
          (('integration-gateway','MANAGED_MCP'),('interaction-gateway','INTERACTION'))
      AND CASE connection.credential_policy
        WHEN 'PROJECT_SHARED' THEN connection.state='CONNECTED' AND (
          definition.credential_secret_key IS NULL OR (
            connection.masked_credentials_state='CONFIGURED' AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.integration_credential_revisions credential
              WHERE credential.id=connection.credential_revision_id
                AND credential.connection_id=connection.id
                AND credential.organization_id=connection.organization_id
            )
          )
        )
        WHEN 'INITIATOR_REQUIRED' THEN connection.state IN ('NOT_CONNECTED','CONNECTED')
          AND definition.adapter_owner='integration-gateway'
          AND definition.execution_route='MANAGED_MCP'
        ELSE false
      END
    FROM control_plane.integration_connections connection
    JOIN control_plane.integration_definitions definition ON definition.stable_key=connection.definition_key
    WHERE connection.id=p_connection_id
),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.integration_grant_admission(p_tenant uuid, p_actor uuid, p_authority_project uuid, p_connection_ref text, p_project_ref text, p_recipient_kind text, p_recipient_ref text, p_capability_key text, p_purpose text, p_workflow_capabilities text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(connection_id uuid, connection_ref text, connection_version bigint, definition_key text, definition_version text, definition_digest text, project_id uuid, project_ref text, project_name text, project_version bigint, recipient_kind text, recipient_ref text, recipient_name text, recipient_version bigint, capability_key text, capability_name text, reason text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'control_plane'
AS $function$
WITH recipients AS (
    SELECT agent.organization_id, agent.project_id, agent.id, agent.ref,
           agent.name, agent.version, agent.created_by,
           'AGENT'::text AS kind,
           CASE p_purpose WHEN 'GRANT' THEN 'agent.manage' ELSE 'agent.view' END AS permission,
           agent.enabled AND agent.state='READY' AS ready
    FROM control_plane.agents agent
    WHERE agent.organization_id=p_tenant AND agent.state<>'ARCHIVED'
      AND p_recipient_kind IN ('', 'AGENT')
      AND (p_recipient_ref='' OR agent.ref=p_recipient_ref)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT workflow.organization_id, workflow.project_id, workflow.id, workflow.ref,
           workflow.name, workflow.version, workflow.created_by,
           'WORKFLOW', 'workflow.manage', workflow.state IN ('DRAFT','VALID','PUBLISHED')
    FROM control_plane.workflows workflow
    WHERE workflow.organization_id=p_tenant AND workflow.state<>'ARCHIVED'
      AND p_recipient_kind IN ('', 'WORKFLOW') AND p_purpose='GRANT'
      AND (p_recipient_ref='' OR workflow.ref=p_recipient_ref)
), connections AS (
    SELECT connection.*, definition.enabled AS definition_enabled,
           definition.adapter_readiness, definition.adapter_owner, definition.execution_route,
           (definition.credential_secret_key IS NULL OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.integration_credential_revisions credential
               WHERE credential.id=connection.credential_revision_id
                 AND credential.connection_id=connection.id AND credential.organization_id=p_tenant
                 AND connection.masked_credentials_state='CONFIGURED'
           )) AS credential_ready,
           CASE WHEN connection.definition_version=definition.definition_version
                     AND connection.definition_digest=definition.digest
                     OR (connection.definition_key='email'
                         AND connection.definition_version='1.4.0'
                         AND connection.definition_digest='df52f45643b6e4464cf20901b6c069b88dac671303dc31e04f23b3d1ad4006fd'
                         AND definition.definition_version='1.4.1'
                         AND definition.digest='19015eb96a6e5e3edfd8abe9cd885adf8fc82582149dce88421c81dab19424a0')
                THEN definition.capabilities
                WHEN connection.definition_key='github'
                  AND control_plane.integration_github_legacy_capabilities(
                    definition.definition_version,definition.digest,connection.definition_version,connection.definition_digest) IS NOT NULL
                THEN control_plane.integration_github_legacy_capabilities(
                    definition.definition_version,definition.digest,connection.definition_version,connection.definition_digest)
                WHEN connection.definition_key='jira-server-dc'
                  AND (definition.definition_version,definition.digest,connection.definition_version,connection.definition_digest)
                    = ('1.1.0','fc35495f83ec21d3698c1e7cfa37eec1075ad35dd30b9dd7f9f680acf989cb31','1.0.0','838878a5a984dafaa8d1c46563e3e660fc3b074515e25376e53ae0cae204fec8')
                THEN definition.capabilities
                ELSE (
                    SELECT revision.content::jsonb #> '{spec,capabilities}'
                    FROM control_plane.managed_configuration_bindings binding
                    JOIN control_plane.managed_configuration_sets configuration
                      ON configuration.id=binding.configuration_set_id
                     AND configuration.organization_id=binding.organization_id
                    JOIN control_plane.managed_configuration_revisions revision
                      ON revision.id=binding.configuration_revision_id
                     AND revision.organization_id=binding.organization_id
                     AND revision.configuration_set_id=configuration.id
                    WHERE binding.organization_id=p_tenant
                      AND binding.consumer_kind='INTEGRATION_CONNECTION'
                      AND binding.consumer_ref=connection.ref
                      AND binding.configuration_kind='INTEGRATION_DEFINITION'
                      AND configuration.kind='INTEGRATION_DEFINITION'
                      AND revision.state='PUBLISHED' AND revision.content_format='JSON'
                      AND encode(public.digest(convert_to(revision.content,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')=connection.definition_digest
                      AND revision.content::jsonb #>> '{metadata,key}'=connection.definition_key
                      AND revision.content::jsonb #>> '{metadata,version}'=connection.definition_version
                ) END AS actual_capabilities
    FROM control_plane.integration_connections connection
    JOIN control_plane.integration_definitions definition ON definition.stable_key=connection.definition_key
    WHERE connection.organization_id=p_tenant AND connection.lifecycle_state='ACTIVE'
      AND (p_connection_ref='' OR connection.ref=p_connection_ref)
      AND (control_plane.catalog_resource_visible(p_tenant,p_actor,'integration.manage','INTEGRATION',
          connection.id,NULL,connection.created_by,'{}'::jsonb,transaction_timestamp())
        OR (p_purpose='USE' AND control_plane.catalog_resource_visible(p_tenant,p_actor,'integration.view','INTEGRATION',
          connection.id,NULL,connection.created_by,'{}'::jsonb,transaction_timestamp())))
)
SELECT connection.id, connection.ref, connection.version,
       connection.definition_key, connection.definition_version, connection.definition_digest,
       project.id, project.ref, project.name, project.version,
       recipient.kind, recipient.ref, recipient.name, recipient.version,
       capability.value->>'key', capability.value->>'name',
       CASE
         WHEN ((p_purpose='GRANT' OR connection.credential_policy='INITIATOR_REQUIRED') AND NOT control_plane.integration_connection_configuration_ready(connection.id))
              OR (p_purpose='USE' AND connection.credential_policy='PROJECT_SHARED' AND (NOT connection.enabled OR connection.state<>'CONNECTED' OR NOT connection.credential_ready))
              OR NOT connection.definition_enabled OR connection.adapter_readiness<>'READY'
              OR (connection.adapter_owner,connection.execution_route) NOT IN
                 (('integration-gateway','MANAGED_MCP'),('interaction-gateway','INTERACTION'))
           THEN 'CONNECTION_UNAVAILABLE'
         WHEN NOT recipient.ready THEN 'RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE'
         WHEN p_purpose='USE' AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.integration_grants grant_row
           WHERE grant_row.organization_id=p_tenant AND grant_row.connection_id=connection.id
             AND grant_row.target_kind='AGENT' AND grant_row.target_ref=recipient.ref
             AND grant_row.capability_key=capability.value->>'key' AND grant_row.enabled
             AND grant_row.definition_version=connection.definition_version
             AND grant_row.definition_digest=connection.definition_digest
         ) THEN 'GRANT_UNAVAILABLE'
         WHEN p_purpose='USE' AND p_workflow_capabilities IS NOT NULL
           AND NOT (capability.value->>'key'=ANY(p_workflow_capabilities)) THEN 'WORKFLOW_EXCLUDED'
         ELSE 'READY'
       END
FROM recipients recipient
JOIN control_plane.projects project ON project.id=recipient.project_id
 AND project.organization_id=p_tenant AND project.lifecycle='ACTIVE'
CROSS JOIN connections connection
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(connection.actual_capabilities) capability(value)
WHERE p_purpose IN ('GRANT','USE')
  AND (p_project_ref='' OR project.ref=p_project_ref)
  AND (p_authority_project IS NULL OR project.id=p_authority_project)
  AND (p_capability_key='' OR capability.value->>'key'=p_capability_key)
  AND control_plane.catalog_resource_visible(p_tenant,p_actor,recipient.permission,recipient.kind,
      recipient.id,project.id,recipient.created_by,
      jsonb_build_object('PROJECT',project.id::text),transaction_timestamp())
  AND (p_purpose='GRANT' OR (
      capability.value->>'operation' NOT IN ('mattermost.inbound','mattermost.gate_decisions')
      AND capability.value->>'risk' IN ('READ','WRITE','SENSITIVE','DESTRUCTIVE')
      AND control_plane.catalog_resource_visible(p_tenant,p_actor,
          CASE capability.value->>'risk' WHEN 'READ' THEN 'integration.view' ELSE 'integration.manage' END,
          'INTEGRATION',connection.id,NULL,connection.created_by,'{}'::jsonb,transaction_timestamp())
  ));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.protect_integration_approval_scope_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM control_plane.owner_gates gate
        JOIN control_plane.runs run ON run.id=gate.root_run_id AND run.organization_id=gate.organization_id
        JOIN control_plane.integration_invocations invocation ON invocation.id=gate.integration_invocation_id
          AND invocation.organization_id=gate.organization_id
        JOIN control_plane.run_nodes node ON node.id=invocation.node_id AND node.organization_id=gate.organization_id
        WHERE gate.id=NEW.origin_gate_id AND gate.organization_id=NEW.organization_id
          AND gate.root_run_id=NEW.root_run_id AND run.id=NEW.root_run_id
          AND gate.project_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.project_id
          AND run.project_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.project_id
          AND node.agent_id=NEW.agent_id AND invocation.connection_id=NEW.connection_id AND invocation.grant_id=NEW.grant_id
          AND (gate.scope_kind='PROJECT' OR (gate.scope_kind='ORGANIZATION'
              AND control_plane.owned_organization_assistant_run(NEW.organization_id,NEW.root_run_id)))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'integration approval scope owner mismatch';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION control_plane.revoke_integration_approval_scopes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'integration_grants' THEN
        IF NEW.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.enabled OR NEW.version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.version
           OR NEW.approval_policy IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approval_policy
           OR NEW.approval_scope_paths IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approval_scope_paths
           OR NEW.definition_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_version
           OR NEW.definition_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_digest
           OR NEW.resource_scope_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.resource_scope_digest THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_approval_scopes
            SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE grant_id=OLD.id AND revoked_at IS NULL;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'integration_connections' THEN
        IF NEW.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.enabled OR NEW.state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.state
           OR NEW.definition_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_version
           OR NEW.definition_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_digest THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_approval_scopes
            SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE connection_id=OLD.id AND revoked_at IS NULL;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'integration_definitions' THEN
        IF NEW.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.enabled OR NEW.digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.digest
           OR NEW.definition_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition_version
           OR NEW.adapter_readiness IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.adapter_readiness THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_approval_scopes scope
            SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp()
            WHERE scope.connection_id IN (
                SELECT connection.id FROM control_plane.integration_connections connection
                WHERE connection.definition_key=OLD.stable_key
            ) AND scope.revoked_at IS NULL;
        END IF;
    ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'runs' THEN
        IF NEW.state IN ('CANCELLING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NEW.state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.state THEN
            UPDATE control_plane.integration_approval_scopes
            SET revoked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE root_run_id=OLD.id AND revoked_at IS NULL;
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
